body:
You are talking about incrementing, while also settings the page parameter to the same value as it currently is. Once you set a parameter, the page is automatically reset to 0, since that would be the default behaviour once you apply a filter. A solution is to do the following:

```js
const page = helper.state.page
helper.setQueryParameter('filters', 'date_timestamp:1538352000 TO 1540944000')
  .setPage(page)
  .search();
```
